cards.subject: The Athenaeum
lines: The Library wing is a real library and the Cathedral is a real cathedral, with prayer rooms behind the altar. This was Alonsus Faol's seat, a Holy Light archive and a paladin seminary.
You are fighting inside a working religious campus that was never built for any of this.

cards.subject: Four doors, one building
cards.tag: You choose before you go in
lines: Graveyard, Library, Armory, Cathedral — four separate instances behind four doors off the same vestibule.
Ten people fit. That cap arrived in patch 1.3.0; before it there was no limit at all.
The Armory and Cathedral stay locked until somebody has the key.

cards.subject: How the Crusade happened
lines: After the Third War the Knights of the Silver Hand took this monastery as a defensive position in Tirisfal.
Then the order broke in two — Argent Dawn one way, Scarlet Crusade the other. The Crusade kept the building and renamed it.
Everyone you kill in here is standing in a paladin order's old house.

cards.subject: Interrogator Vishas
lines: He has been working on the Forsaken Vorrel Sengutz for weeks.
He took Sengutz's wedding ring off him and gave it to his own wife, who lives out in Tirisfal.
"Tell me... tell me everything!" And when he wins: "Purged by pain!"

cards.subject: Bloodmage Thalnos
lines: He made his name in the Crusade for the torture he used to purify new recruits.
Then he caught the plague, died, and rose as a skeleton.
He is still in their own graveyard, under the far staircase, hostile to everyone. "No rest, for the angry dead."

cards.subject: Three things in the Cloister
lines: Azshir the Sleepless, Fallen Champion, Ironspine.
Nothing marks them. You walk the graves and find out which one is home.

cards.subject: Arcanist Doan
lines: "You will not defile these mysteries!" He keeps the Athenaeum, and that is what he dies for.
He carries the Scarlet Key, which opens the Armory and Cathedral doors.
A rogue's picks or a large seaforium charge do the same job.

cards.subject: Herod, the Scarlet Champion
lines: He opens with "Ah, I've been waiting for a real challenge" and then whirlwinds across the Armory floor.
When he dies, twenty Scarlet Trainees pour out of the training hall to avenge him.
Each one falls to a single hit.

cards.subject: Who is talking to you
lines: Arcanist Doan is Chris Metzen.
Herod, Bloodmage Thalnos and Houndmaster Loksey are all Marc Graue.
Most of the people in this building are the same two men.

cards.subject: The torch in the prayer room
lines: In the right-hand prayer room behind the Cathedral altar, a wall torch opens a hidden chamber.
Fairbanks is inside, and he is undead. The Crusade's own inquisitor, kept in a sealed room.
He was the witness. He heard the cries when Alexandros Mograine died.

cards.subject: Scarlet Commander Mograine
lines: He is the elder son of Highlord Alexandros Mograine, who carried the Ashbringer.
Renault lured his father into an ambush and killed him with his own sword.
That is the act that fouled the blade.

cards.subject: The first kill does not count
lines: Put Mograine down and she runs in: "Mograine has fallen? You shall pay for this treachery!"
Then Scarlet Resurrection on the corpse — "Arise, my champion!" — and he stands back up.
"At your side, milady."

cards.subject: Walk in wearing the Ashbringer
lines: Carry the Corrupted Ashbringer into the Cathedral and the entire Scarlet Crusade stops fighting and bows. Renault welcomes you as their lord.
Then his father steps out of the blade in full Dreadnaught plate and kills him in front of everyone.
Almost nobody will ever see it. The sword drops in Naxxramas.
